rundown: Sooners beat Rebels 24-17 at Memorial Stadium (Norman, OK) in Norman, OK in front of 98,374. Sooners led 14-7 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Sooners won it 14-0.
Scoring: Rebels 2 touchdowns and 1 field goal; Sooners 3 touchdowns and 1 field goal. The last score: Lucas Carneiro 41 Yd Field Goal (4th quarter, 0:42).

Leading the way — Rebels: Trinidad Chambliss 14/27, 127 yds, 1 TD, 11 car, 84 yds; Caleb Odom 4 rec, 56 yds, 1 TD. Sooners: John Mateer 10/19, 111 yds, 16 car, 70 yds, 1 TD; Rocky Beers 4 rec, 39 yds.
Where Sooners won it: they held the ball 36:31 to 23:29.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Sooners closed as 2.5-point favorites and covered by 4.5; the total closed at 48.5 and they combined for 41, under by 7.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Rebuilt after the final from pre-game data only: the tracker hadn't logged this game before it started, so the call was made from the final's scoreboard row (its closing odds, when posted) and both teams' season numbers with this game taken back out of them. It had Rebels 48% and Sooners 52%, projecting Rebels 24.9 – Sooners 25.5 (50.4 total, Sooners by 0.6).

Final: Rebels 17 – Sooners 24. Right winner: it had Sooners at 52%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Rebels came in with a 32% above average attack and a 27% stingier than average defense (6-3, 33.8 scored and 26 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 178 and 190 games of evidence. Projected to score 24.9, they scored 17 (−7.9 points, 32% under); projected to allow 25.5, they allowed 24 (−1.5 points, 6% under).

Sooners came in with a 20% above average attack and a 25% stingier than average defense (5-4, 22.1 scored and 19.2 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 182 and 191 games of evidence. Projected to score 25.5, they scored 24 (−1.5 points, 6% under); projected to allow 24.9, they allowed 17 (−7.9 points, 32% under).

The bigger miss was Rebels' scoring (-7.9 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 41 against 50.4 projected (-9.4), about the 27th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Sooners by 7 against Sooners by 0.6 projected, about the 66th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against; the call was rebuilt after the fact rather than logged live.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.767 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +5.2 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 130 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Rebels attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (4 games); Sooners attack ×1.020, defense ×0.960 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
